title: Soul Feast #65: How Can I Change the World from the New Consciousness?
excerpt: Are you ready to live Beyond the Five Senses?
bodyHtml:
Are you ready to live Beyond the Five Senses? Learn How Here.

A profound shift is underway in humanity, and in this Soul Feast, Gary Zukav explores the question so many people hold today: 

How can I change the world from the new consciousness? 

He begins by illuminating the difference between the old five-sensory perception – rooted in control, manipulation, and external power – and the new multisensory consciousness emerging across the human species. This new awareness recognizes that we are more than bodies and minds, and that true transformation begins with the alignment of the personality with the soul. Rather than focusing on changing the outer world, Gary guides listeners toward the deeper, internal work that actually reshapes experience and expands perception.

Gary then delves into the core misunderstanding of the old consciousness: the belief that painful emotional experiences come from the outside world. From the new consciousness, we see that the world only activates inner dynamics already within us. This creates a powerful opportunity – not to fix the world, but to identify the physical sensations of our emotions, cultivate emotional literacy, and choose to act from the loving parts of our personalities instead of the frightened parts. This is what creates authentic power, and this is how the world truly changes.

Ultimately, Gary shares that the only way to change the world is to change yourself. When you become more loving, more kind, and less reactive, the world you live in shifts – because in the new consciousness, “in here” and “out there” are not separate. Transformation happens from the inside out, and every loving choice expands your awareness and the role you play in the unfolding evolution of humanity.

What You’ll Discover in This Soul Feast:

(00:30) — The defining differences between the old five-sensory consciousness and the emerging multisensory consciousness

(02:05) — Why external power – manipulation and control – once served human evolution but now creates only violence and destruction

(05:10) — How the new consciousness shifts the focus from changing the world to transforming yourself from the inside

(08:45) — Emotional literacy: how identifying physical sensations in the chest, throat, and solar plexus expands awareness

(11:40) — How choosing to act from the loving parts of your personality creates authentic power

(14:55) — Why fear and love form the fundamental duality of the Earth school and how recognizing this changes everything

(18:20) — How dissolving the illusion of “in here” vs. “out there” reveals that changing yourself is changing the world

(19:32) — A practical Soul Step for noticing where the “barrier” between inner and outer might be disappearing

Embrace the Soul Step Challenge

Take a few quiet moments with your notebook and write about your experience of the “barrier” between your inner world and the outer world. Have you always believed they were separate? Are you beginning to sense that the boundary is thinner – or perhaps not there at all? Reflect on whether this shift signals the emergence of the new consciousness within you. Throughout the week, notice moments when you feel this connection more clearly, and let these insights guide your choices toward love.
